To secure the full and punctual payment of all Secured Obligations when due, whether by acceleration or otherwise, Meridian Fiber Networks Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Debtor"), hereby grants to Citibank, N.A., as Collateral Agent for the benefit of the Secured Parties, a continuing security interest in, and a general lien upon and right of set-off against, all right, title, and interest of the Debtor in, to, and under all personal property, assets, and fixtures, whether now owned or hereafter acquired or arising, including without limitation all fiber optic cable routes, conduit networks, switching equipment, accounts receivable, intellectual property, and proceeds thereof, subject only to Permitted Encumbrances and the express carve-outs set forth in Section 4.2 regarding certain Excluded Accounts; provided, however, that the security interest granted hereunder shall automatically attach without further act upon the acquisition of any after-acquired collateral, and the Debtor covenants to execute such further Uniform Commercial Code financing statements and control agreements as the Collateral Agent may reasonably request to perfect such security interest, provided further that the aggregate book value of all unperfected collateral permitted under the basket in Section 7.1 shall not exceed five million dollars ($5,000,000) at any one time.

{"clause_type": "security_collateral", "parties": ["Meridian Fiber Networks Inc.", "Citibank, N.A."], "obligation": "The Debtor must grant a continuing security interest in all personal property, assets, and fixtures to the Collateral Agent and execute necessary perfection documents, subject to specified carve-outs and baskets.", "trigger_condition": null, "financial_terms": ["Section 4.2", "Section 7.1", "five million dollars ($5,000,000)"], "risk_flag": "high", "risk_rationale": "Comprehensive all-assets security grants primary recovery rights to lenders upon enforcement, directly impacting recovery rates."}

Section 14.1 Governing Law. This Agreement, the Notes, and all non-contractual obligations arising out of or in connection with them shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany, without regard to its conflict of laws principles and excluding the application of the United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. Section 14.2 Jurisdiction. Subject to Section 14.3, the courts of Frankfurt am Main, Federal Republic of Germany, shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute, controversy, or claim arising from, relating to, or having any connection with this Agreement, including any question regarding its formation, existence, validity, interpretation, performance, breach, or termination (a "Dispute"). Each of Bavaria Hotel Operations GmbH, as the Borrower, and Bayerische Landesbodenkreditanstalt, as the Facility Agent, irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of such courts and waives any objection to proceedings in such courts on the grounds of venue or on the grounds that the proceedings have been brought in an inconvenient forum. Section 14.3 Arbitration Exception. Notwithstanding Section 14.2, any Finance Party may, at its sole election, initiate arbitration proceedings under the rules of the German Institution of Arbitration (DIS) with the place of arbitration being Frankfurt am Main, provided that such election is made prior to the formal service of process in any court action.

{"clause_type": "governing_law_jurisdiction", "parties": ["Bavaria Hotel Operations GmbH", "Bayerische Landesbodenkreditanstalt", "Finance Party"], "obligation": "The parties must submit all disputes arising from the agreement to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Frankfurt am Main, subject to the Finance Party's right to elect arbitration under DIS rules.", "trigger_condition": "A dispute, controversy, or claim arises from, relates to, or has any connection with this Agreement.", "financial_terms": ["14.1", "14.2", "14.3"], "risk_flag": "low", "risk_rationale": "Procedural clause specifying German law and Frankfurt forum; material only if enforcement or litigation becomes necessary."}

Solarsphere Hamburg GmbH covenants in favour of Deutsche Windfinanz AG that, at all times during the continuation of the Facility Agreement, it shall not, and shall ensure that no Project Subsidiary shall, directly or indirectly, incur, assume or suffer to exist any Financial Indebtedness, or declare, make or pay any dividend, charge, fee or other distribution (whether in cash or in kind) on or in respect of its share capital, or dispose of, transfer, lease or otherwise drop any material asset comprising the renewable energy portfolio, except that: (a) Permitted Encumbrances and ordinary course trade credit arising in the ordinary course of business shall be permitted; (b) the Borrower may incur additional Financial Indebtedness up to an aggregate principal amount of EUR 12,500,000 at any one time outstanding, provided that the Debt Service Coverage Ratio is not less than 1.35:1.00 on a pro forma basis; and (c) restricted payments may be made pursuant to Clause 14.4 (Permitted Distributions) provided that no Default is continuing or would occur as a consequence thereof and the aggregate amount of such dividends does not exceed EUR 3,000,000 in any single financial year.
